# Floor: the arcade's carpet, 9 x 6.5 m, top at z 0 (the world's y -0.82 under the table), a slate
# carpet with plum confetti (textures/carpet.png, drawn by make_env.py) projected from the top.
# Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Carpet --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Carpet base-color textures/carpet.png
add mesh cube --name Floor --size 1 --location 0 0.75 -0.1
scale 9 6.5 0.2
apply --scale
material assign Carpet
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
shade flat
export floor.glb
